_comment: An example pack. Import it from the Anywhere panel.
It contains three cues showing the three ways to bind loops to places:
by type (any gym), by name (a place called Omega Music), and by
coordinate (that specific building, wherever it is).
Edit the lat/lng in 'My local gym' to somewhere near you, or the cue
will never fire. Everything else works as-is.
Pattern numbers are scale degrees relative to the current chord, so
these riffs stay in key under any theme.

cues.name: Gym
cues._note: Fires near ANY gym. A driving riff and a stomp on top of whatever theme is playing.

cues.name: Record shop
cues._note: Fires at any place whose NAME contains this. Swaps the whole theme rather than layering.

cues.name: My local gym
cues._note: Fires within 120 m of ONE building. Change lat/lng to somewhere you actually go.
